description: Use this when the user wants a podcast, interview, stream or other video turned into short clips. An audio-only episode (MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG or FLAC) works too: its clips come out as captioned vertical videos drawn with an audio template. With a video or audio file attached in the chat, pass it as file: it is copied into Slice, transcribed, and searched for the moments worth posting, with no further steps. With no file, it returns an upload_url for the user to open and drop the file in (up to three hours and 4.5GB). Follow with get_episode. If the user shared a video without saying what they want, ASK FIRST: "Find the best clips in it, or edit the whole video as one piece?". For the whole video pass purpose "whole": Slice only transcribes it (no clip search, no clips email), then make_clips with one stretch from 0 to its full length makes it one clip (10 minutes at most; a longer video must be split into parts or turned into clips). Do not use when the user only wants the words as text (use transcribe_audio), and do not use for links to YouTube or other web pages; those are not supported.

content_type.description: What kind of video it is, which decides how clips are found: podcast (a podcast or interview), stream (a livestream or gaming video) or other (a vlog, challenge, talk or story). Pass it when the user's video is clearly one of these. Otherwise leave it out and Slice will guess.

file.description: A video or audio file the user attached in the conversation.

name.description: What to call the episode. Defaults to the file name.

purpose.description: "clips" (default): Slice finds the best clips. "whole": edit the whole video as one piece, with no clip search; ask the user first when they have not said.

target_seconds.description: Optional. How long each clip should be, in seconds (15 to 180), when the user asks for a length, e.g. "30 second clips". Every clip found then plays for at most this long and at most 10% less (at least 3 seconds less), cut at clean sentence or pause boundaries; fewer clips come back if few moments fit. Leave it out for clips of any length (30 to 150 seconds). Works with or without a focus.

name: start_episode

upload_url.description: Open this to upload the video or audio file. Works for two hours.

title: Start an episode
